scientific_integrity: Proof is elementary and complete within the stated scope; finite tests check instances but are not treated as proof. Two-term classification and parity principle are credited to prior work. Public source date is the earliest day-precise verifiable motivating reference; earlier journal work is listed without inventing a release day.
scientific_limitations: Fixed horizons only: no general termination conclusion; explicit general period may be nonminimal; the residual \(1/5\) of odd denominators in the numerator-two family has not stopped by four steps, with later outcomes unknown. A possibly equivalent consequence of general fixed-prefix parametrizations remains a literature priority risk.
title: Finite-horizon periodicity and a sharp four-term census for odd-greedy Egyptian fractions
